subject: Television & Streaming
title: Captain Kangaroo and Children's TV
description: A short lesson to help you apply Captain Kangaroo and Children's TV.

hook.text: Before Sesame Street, Captain Kangaroo taught kids to be kind for 29 years on CBS every weekday morning.

buildup.text: Bob Keeshan played the Captain with gentle warmth. He read stories, played with puppets, and never raised his voice.

discovery.text: Keeshan insisted on no violence and no hard-sell toy ads during his show. He fought sponsors constantly.

twist.text: CBS eventually moved the show to earlier time slots to make room for profitable morning news programs.

climax.text: Captain Kangaroo proved children's TV could be gentle and profitable—until the network decided it couldn't.

punchline.text: Kindness on TV was canceled for better ratings.

quiz.question: How long did Captain Kangaroo air on CBS?
